prompt_md: You mix 1 litre of drink that is 10% fruit juice with 3 litres of drink that is 50% fruit juice. What percent of the mixture is fruit juice?
prompt_short: 1 L of 10% juice plus 3 L of 50% juice. Percent juice?
hint_md: Count litres of juice, not percentages.
explain_intuition_md: Averaging 10% and 50% gives 30%, but there's three times as much of the strong drink. It drags the mix most of the way toward 50%.
